children: By Yantoultra Ngui and Scott Murdoch
is offering 5- and 10-year offshore yuan bonds, or dim sum bonds, with initial price guidance of around 2.90% for the 5-year and 3.60% for the 10-year, according to a term sheet seen by Reuters.
Meituan plans to use the proceeds to refinance existing offshore debt and for general corporate purposes
Reuters reported on Monday that Meituan aimed to raise about 7 billion yuan ($1.05 billion) through the deal
The bonds are senior unsecured debt, meaning they are not backed by specific assets
The bonds are expected to receive Baa1 ratings from Moody's and BBB+ ratings from S&P Global Ratings and Fitch. All three rating agencies have negative outlooks on Meituan's issuer ratings
CITIC Securities, Goldman Sachs, BofA Securities, China Construction Bank, ICBC, Bank of Communications and HSBC are among the lead banks for the deal
